item.title: A new chapter begins for Ruff Majik with the release of latest single Can Of Wyrms
item.description: A new chapter begins for Ruff Majik with the release of latest single Can Of Wyrms South African heavy rock outfit Ruff Majik return with Can Of Wyrms, a stark and emotionally unguarded single that confronts suicide from the perspective of those left behind. Rather than romanticizing loss or framing it through spectacle, Can Of Wyrms documents grief as an ongoing presence — unresolved, heavy, and communal.
